difficultyGuide: Difficulty is on a 1-15 scale. 1-3 is easy everyday general knowledge; 4-6 is moderate; 7-9 is hard; 10 is really, really fiendish - obscure, specialist-level knowledge that only someone deeply into the topic would know; 11-13 is very obscure; 14-15 is near-impossible expert trivia. This quiz is set at difficulty 7: hard but gettable by a keen quizzer, and a good score is a solid one.
rules: All 15 questions must be original. Never copy another publication's quiz.
Exactly 8 multiple choice (4 options each) and 7 type-the-answer.
Five groups of three questions, using the group/category mapping in this file.
Any question whose answer is a number, a year, a date, a count or a measurement must be multiple choice, never type-the-answer.
Typed answers must be checkable generously: a correct answer with a misspelling or incomplete wording still counts.
Never repeat a question already in used-questions.json. Check every new question against it.
Every question needs one unambiguous correct answer, plausible wrong options for multiple choice, and a short true interesting fact.
If an answer is uncertain, replace the question rather than guessing.
Current-events questions must be based only on the supplied headlines, and must be accurate. If no headline supports a good question, use an extra question from a high-weight category instead.
